acceptance.given: A proposed Toolchain change includes a write target under `_bmad/`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/`, or `.agents/skills/gds-*/`.

oracle.expected: The Toolchain governance-policy evaluation rejects the protected target before any write is accepted, and reports the installed BMAD/GDS boundary violation.
forbidden: Any installed BMAD/GDS Skill file is modified.
PhaseA.Platform or runtime/phase-a is used as the implementation or verification owner.
oracle.observable: The protected-path negative fixture produces a deterministic rejection from the governance-policy check.

acceptance.then: The proposed write is blocked and no protected installed Skill path enters the permitted change set.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain governance guard evaluates the proposed repository-relative write path.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or bypass the policy rule that classifies `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**` as forbidden installed Skill write targets.
Submit a protected installed BMAD/GDS repository-relative write target through the same governance-policy evaluation path and require deterministic rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce a Toolchain-only governance boundary that rejects proposed writes to installed `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**` paths before they can be accepted; this permission does not authorize modification of those installed paths.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No protected-path write may be performed; reverting the guard implementation restores only prior Toolchain policy behavior and does not modify installed Skill files.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unguarded proposed installed-Skill write transitions to a deterministically rejected protected-path proposal.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The governance-policy evaluation rejects every proposed repository-relative path within `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, or `.agents/skills/gds-*/**`, with no write accepted or applied.
